syllabus.clause: historians (e.g. AVEVA PI System) store tags with exception (deadband) filtering then swinging-door trending compression that keeps only points needed to reconstruct within an error band;

at.step: Reveal: exception filtering drops points before the archive sees them
Reveal: swinging-door compression keeps only the knees
Reveal: the error band holds, measured against the original signal
Reveal: a flat hold and a short excursion compress very differently
Reveal: a time-weighted average gets it right
Reveal: a step series needs step interpolation, not a line

syllabus.clause: extracting historian data into a lakehouse without losing compression semantics.

at.step: Prove it

items.item: exception is a simple deadband to filter noise, performed by PI Interfaces, reducing events sent to the Data Archive Snapshot and conserving network bandwidth

at.step: Reveal: exception filtering drops points before the archive sees them

items.item: swinging-door compression eliminates data that can safely be recreated with interpolation, aiming to filter noise while still recording significant process changes; out-of-order data bypasses compression

at.step: Reveal: swinging-door compression keeps only the knees

items.item: two swinging doors pivot on offset points as data arrives; an end point (knee) is recorded when the doors would open wider than parallel

at.step: Reveal: swinging-door compression keeps only the knees

items.item: Compressed Data returns the actual archived data at uneven intervals; Sampled Data retrieves evenly spaced interpolated values instead

at.step: Reveal: a time-weighted average gets it right

items.item: PI's own By Time Range summaries include Average (time-weighted) as a distinct aggregation

at.step: Reveal: a time-weighted average gets it right

items.item: A historian being several degrees off isn't a bug report — it's the compression setting someone chose years ago, still quietly shaping every average computed on top of it today.

at.step: Hook: a historian's own mean comes out degrees off the plant's

items.item: The honest prediction isn't a bigger sample of the same stored rows — it's that the calculation itself has to change, from counting rows to weighting time, and the extraction has to carry forward what each row actually is.

at.step: Predict: what would have given the right mean?

items.item: A deadband applied before anything reaches the archive isn't a storage optimization bolted on afterward — it's a decision about which moments ever got the chance to be recorded at all.

at.step: Reveal: exception filtering drops points before the archive sees them

items.item: A door that can no longer stay parallel to its twin isn't a geometric curiosity — it's the exact instant the straight line stopped being an honest description of what happened.

at.step: Reveal: swinging-door compression keeps only the knees

items.item: An error band that holds under measurement, not just under description, is the difference between a compression scheme and a compression claim.

at.step: Reveal: the error band holds, measured against the original signal

items.item: Two periods of equal clock time ending up with wildly different point counts is not a flaw in the compression — it's the compression doing its one job, which has nothing to do with being a fair sample.

at.step: Reveal: a flat hold and a short excursion compress very differently

items.item: Calling two different calculations by the same word, 'average,' is exactly how a correct-looking query quietly returns the wrong number.

at.step: Reveal: a time-weighted average gets it right

items.item: A step and a ramp are not the same claim about what happened between two stored points, and treating them the same is a choice, not a default.

at.step: Reveal: a step series needs step interpolation, not a line

items.item: Every piece of this topic reduces to the same move: a compressed archive is a true record of what it decided to keep, and every later calculation has to be built around that decision, not around what it would have liked to have.

at.step: Recap

items.item: A value with no flag telling you how it was produced is not neutral data — it is a claim about reality with its own origin quietly deleted.

at.step: Prove it

items.item: Choosing CompDev and ExcDev isn't a tuning knob tucked away in an admin panel — it's an analytic decision, made once by whoever configured the tag, binding every number anyone ever extracts from it afterward.

at.step: Hook: a historian's own mean comes out degrees off the plant's
